label: Flipping search bar
desc: A search button that flips in 3D to reveal an input, flips back on blur or Escape, and filters a suggestions list with arrow-key selection.
use: site header search, help centre, dashboard toolbar

label: Liquid glass nav
desc: A glass pill indicator that stretches between items with a separate spring on each edge; the active label turns neon. Arrow-key roving tabindex.
use: landing header, mobile tab bar, dashboard section switcher

label: Rotating button
desc: A pill button whose arrow rotates 45 degrees while the label slides on hover or keyboard focus.
use: hero call to action, card links, contact section

label: Underline nav
desc: Navigation links sharing one underline that glides and stretches to the hovered or focused link, then returns to the active one.
use: site header, dashboard sub-navigation, settings tabs

label: Magnetic button
desc: A button that springs toward the pointer within a radius, with the label moving a little further; inactive on coarse pointers and reduced motion.
use: landing hero call to action, sign-up, pricing

label: Rolling text button
desc: Label letters roll up and are replaced by a duplicate with a per-letter stagger on hover or focus.
use: landing call to action, navigation links, footer buttons
